newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill falls. [CORRECTED 13:41 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill falls. [CORRECTED 13:41 gmt]

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off price of 90.83 rupees at the fortnightly auction of 364-day treasury bills held on Wednesday, against 89.21 rupees at the previous auction.
Dealers said the yield worked out to 10.12 percent, down from 12.13 percent.
The RBI said it received 63 bids for 15.91 billion rupees of which it accepted 14 for 6.83 billion rupees. (Corrects amount of accepted bids)
The weighted average price was 90.96 rupees, it said.
